description: This file defines the WidgetLoader interface in the org.apache.ofbiz.widget package, which specifies a contract for registering screen widget classes with a factory within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WidgetLoader
classes.description: An interface for loading and registering widget classes into the widget factory.

methods.name: loadWidgets
methods.description: Method to register screen widgets with the widget factory, to be implemented by concrete classes.
